points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 拉格朗日出生于都灵的一个法国家庭，父亲是富有的法国商人。年轻时展现出对数学的浓厚兴趣，17岁时成为都灵炮兵学院的数学教授。这一时期，他开始发展变分法，解决了等周问题，奠定了变分学的基础。1754年，他发表了关于变分法的早期论文，引起了欧洲数学界的关注。在都灵的这段时间，他建立了与欧拉的通信联系，开始了与当时最伟大数学家的学术交流。
points.descriptionEn: Lagrange was born in Turin to a French family of wealthy merchants. He showed early interest in mathematics and became professor of mathematics at the Turin Artillery Academy at age 17. During this period, he developed the calculus of variations, solving the isoperimetric problem and laying the foundation for variational calculus. In 1754, he published his early work on the calculus of variations, attracting attention from European mathematicians. In Turin, he established correspondence with Euler, beginning academic exchange with one of the greatest mathematicians of the time.

points.title: 柏林科学院时期
points.description: 1756年，应欧拉的推荐，拉格朗日受邀担任柏林科学院数学部主任。在柏林的20年间，他完成了大量重要工作，包括发展分析力学、天体力学和数论。他发表了《分析力学》的早期版本，提出了拉格朗日力学体系，这一理论后来成为经典力学的基础。他还研究了月球运动理论，为天文学做出重要贡献。在柏林期间，他与欧拉、达朗贝尔等数学家保持密切联系，共同推动了18世纪数学的发展。
points.descriptionEn: In 1756, at Euler's recommendation, Lagrange was invited to serve as director of the mathematics section of the Berlin Academy. During his 20 years in Berlin, he completed numerous important works, including developing analytical mechanics, celestial mechanics, and number theory. He published early versions of his 'Mécanique Analytique,' proposing the Lagrangian mechanics system, which later became the foundation of classical mechanics. He also studied lunar motion theory, making significant contributions to astronomy. During his Berlin period, he maintained close contact with mathematicians like Euler and d'Alembert, jointly advancing 18th-century mathematics.

points.title: 巴黎科学院任职
points.description: 1766年，拉格朗日接受法国国王路易十六的邀请，前往巴黎担任新建的巴黎科学院的数学部主任。在巴黎，他完成了《分析力学》的最终版本，这部著作被视为力学史上最重要的著作之一。他还研究了代数方程理论，提出了拉格朗日定理，为群论的发展奠定基础。这一时期，他开始关注教育改革，参与了法国科学院的数学教育改革计划。1781年，他因健康原因逐渐减少工作，但仍继续发表重要论文。
points.descriptionEn: In 1766, Lagrange accepted an invitation from King Louis XVI of France to move to Paris as director of the mathematics section of the newly established Paris Academy. In Paris, he completed the final version of his 'Mécanique Analytique,' considered one of the most important works in the history of mechanics. He also studied algebraic equation theory, proposing Lagrange's theorem, which laid the foundation for group theory development. During this period, he began to focus on educational reform, participating in the French Academy's mathematics education reform program. In 1781, he gradually reduced his work due to health issues but continued to publish important papers.

points.title: 法国大革命时期
points.description: 法国大革命期间，拉格朗日留在巴黎，尽管许多科学家选择离开。他参与了新政府的度量衡改革委员会，帮助建立了公制系统。1795年，他成为新成立的法兰西学院的第一批成员。这一时期，他转向研究数论和代数，发表了关于二次型和数论的重要论文。尽管政治动荡，拉格朗日仍保持学术活跃，培养了包括拉普拉斯在内的许多杰出学生。他的晚年工作主要集中在数学基础问题上，对19世纪数学发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: During the French Revolution, Lagrange remained in Paris despite many scientists choosing to leave. He participated in the new government's weights and measures reform committee, helping establish the metric system. In 1795, he became one of the first members of the newly founded Institut de France. During this period, he shifted his focus to number theory and algebra, publishing important papers on quadratic forms and number theory. Despite political turmoil, Lagrange maintained academic activity, mentoring many outstanding students including Laplace. His later work focused on fundamental mathematical problems, profoundly influencing 19th-century mathematics.

points.title: 晚年荣誉
points.description: 1808年，拿破仑授予拉格朗日伯爵头衔和荣誉军团勋章，表彰他对科学的贡献。尽管年事已高，拉格朗日仍继续工作，完成了关于代数方程和数论的最后研究。1813年4月10日，拉格朗日在巴黎逝世，享年76岁。他的葬礼上，拉普拉斯发表悼词，称他为'数学王子'。拉格朗日的遗产包括他在力学、数学分析和数论方面的开创性工作，以及他对数学教育的改革贡献。他的理论成为现代物理学和数学的基础，影响持续至今。
points.descriptionEn: In 1808, Napoleon granted Lagrange the title of Count and the Legion of Honour in recognition of his contributions to science. Despite his advanced age, Lagrange continued to work, completing his final research on algebraic equations and number theory. On April 10, 1813, Lagrange died in Paris at the age of 76. At his funeral, Laplace delivered a eulogy, calling him the 'Prince of Mathematicians.' Lagrange's legacy includes his pioneering work in mechanics, mathematical analysis, and number theory, as well as his contributions to mathematical education reform. His theories became the foundation of modern physics and mathematics, with continuing influence to this day.

supporter.zh: 拉格朗日被视为18世纪最伟大的数学家之一，他的变分法、分析力学和数论工作彻底改变了数学和物理学的发展轨迹。支持者认为他代表了理性主义的巅峰，将数学的严谨性与物理直觉完美结合。他的《分析力学》被誉为'科学诗篇'，通过纯数学方法推导出整个力学体系，展示了数学的强大力量。拉格朗日的工作为后来的拉普拉斯、哈密顿等科学家铺平了道路，成为现代理论物理和数学分析的基石。
supporter.en: Lagrange is regarded as one of the greatest mathematicians of the 18th century, whose work on calculus of variations, analytical mechanics, and number theory revolutionized the development of mathematics and physics. Supporters see him as representing the pinnacle of rationalism, perfectly combining mathematical rigor with physical intuition. His 'Mécanique Analytique' is hailed as a 'scientific poem,' deriving the entire system of mechanics through pure mathematical methods, demonstrating the power of mathematics. Lagrange's work paved the way for later scientists like Laplace and Hamilton, becoming the foundation of modern theoretical physics and mathematical analysis.

critic.zh: 批评者指出拉格朗日的某些工作缺乏创新性，特别是在他早期依赖欧拉成果的情况下。还有人批评他的数学风格过于形式化和抽象，有时牺牲了直观理解。在政治方面，他被指责过于顺从权威，在法国大革命期间没有像其他科学家那样坚持原则。此外，拉格朗日对几何学的相对忽视也被视为一个局限，这影响了19世纪几何学的发展方向。他的某些理论也被后来的科学发展所超越，显示出时代的局限性。
critic.en: Critics point out that some of Lagrange's work lacked originality, particularly in his early dependence on Euler's results. Others criticize his mathematical style as overly formal and abstract, sometimes sacrificing intuitive understanding. Politically, he is accused of being too compliant with authority, not standing on principles like other scientists during the French Revolution. Additionally, Lagrange's relative neglect of geometry is seen as a limitation, affecting the direction of 19th-century geometric development. Some of his theories were later superseded by scientific advancements, showing the limitations of his era.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，拉格朗日被公认为连接18世纪启蒙运动与19世纪数学发展的关键桥梁。他的工作体现了科学革命后数学的专业化和系统化趋势。流行文化中，他常被描绘为理性时代的象征，与拿破仑、拉普拉斯等人物共同构成了法国科学黄金时代的代表。拉格朗日的遗产不仅在于具体定理和理论，更在于他展示了如何将抽象数学应用于解决物理问题，这一方法论影响深远。现代物理学中的拉格朗日力学和数学中的拉格朗日定理都证明了他思想的持久价值。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Lagrange is recognized as a crucial bridge connecting the 18th-century Enlightenment to 19th-century mathematical development. His work embodies the trend toward specialization and systemization in mathematics following the Scientific Revolution. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a symbol of the Age of Reason, alongside figures like Napoleon and Laplace, representing the golden age of French science. Lagrange's legacy lies not only in specific theorems and theories but in demonstrating how abstract mathematics can be applied to solve physical problems—a methodology with far-reaching influence. Lagrangian mechanics in modern physics and Lagrange's theorem in mathematics both attest to the enduring value of his ideas.

self.zh: 代数不过是写出来的几何，几何不过是画出来的代数。
self.en: Algebra is written geometry, geometry is drawn algebra.

others.zh: 拉格朗日是数学科学中最高尚的典范，他将分析提升到前所未有的高度，并赋予它前所未有的优雅。
others.en: Lagrange is the loftiest prototype in the science of mathematics; he raised analysis to a higher power and gave it a new elegance.
